stories.title: Two Mississauga men charged after $86K in coffee machines stolen
stories.summary: In July, police said officers responded to a call for a break-and-enter at Mississauga building. Investigators found that nine-high commercial coffee machines had been stolen.

stories.title: Mistakes continuing to cost slumping Maple Leafs
stories.summary: The Maple Leafs had worked hard to get back on level terms.

stories.title: Landeskog, Avs hand Leafs fourth straight loss
stories.summary: Gabriel Landeskog scored his second goal of the game in the third period as the Colorado Avalanche topped Toronto 6-3 to hand the Maple Leafs their fourth straight regulation loss Tuesday.

stories.title: Critics slam Ford government appointment of York region chair as ‘conflict of interest’
stories.summary: Scarpitti also suggested the appointment was undemocratic because Del Duca could have "overriding power over nine mayors," which he calls a "concentration of power"

stories.title: Jamal Shead shouldering more for depleted Raptors
stories.summary: Just 10 games into the season and the Toronto Raptors are depleted.

stories.title: Dresden keeps up Ontario landfill battle
stories.summary: A town is pushing back on the latest step to advance a controversial landfill and transfer station project, as Premier Doug Ford's government ramps up a search for garbage space.

stories.title: Silver Cross mother calls Wainwright tragedy ‘cold water’ after daughter’s death
stories.summary: Canada's Silver Cross mother says Canadians can support the victims of CFB Wainwright and all military by wearing their poppies and thanking them for their service.

stories.title: Jury convicts Canadian woman who ‘answered ISIS’s call’
stories.summary: The trial of Ammara Amjad was a test of whether Canada could bring to justice women who served the Islamic State.

stories.title: Leafs’ Rielly remains out with lower-body injury
stories.summary: The Maple Leafs' injury list continues to grow.

stories.title: Leonard out for Raptors at least one more week
stories.summary: The Toronto Raptors will have to make do without Kawhi Leonard for at least another week.
